name: ci-systems
description: CI systems MCP server for test run results, flaky test history, and CI job logs

get_test_results.description: Get test results for a commit or PR

get_flaky_tests.description: Get historically flaky tests for a file or module

get_job_log.description: Get full log for a CI job

note: Requires PYTORCH_CI_TOKEN. Install: pip install pytorch-ci-mcp
